briefings.title: The Greatest Threat Humans Just Can't Stomach | with Yuval Noah Harari
briefings.tldr: The rapid development of artificial intelligence represents an unprecedented encounter with an inorganic "alien intelligence" rather than a mere human-controlled tool, threatening to outpace human political systems and render humanity obsolete in a manner reminiscent of the Aztec Empire's fatal misunderstanding of the Spanish conquistadors.

briefings.title: The full-length interview with Yuval Noah Harari | The Economist
briefings.tldr: AI is the biggest psychological and social experiment in human history, threatening to take control of human civilization within a decade through mass-produced intimacy, algorithmic trust, and centralized power, unless society deliberately slows down and reclaims control.

briefings.title: Yuval Noah Harari on the dangers of an AI future | The Economist
briefings.tldr: Yuval Noah Harari warns that while an AI takeover of finance, politics, and relationships within a decade is not inevitable, humanity is running out of time to maintain control.

briefings.title: AI has hacked the code of human civilization | Yuval Noah Harari
briefings.tldr: AI functions as an agent rather than a tool, threatening to overtake human civilization not through physical force like a Terminator, but by mastering language and bureaucracies—the foundational systems that build trust and large-scale cooperation.
